annotations.title: Does this person follow the Instagram account?

description: Check whether a person follows the brand's Instagram account (and whether the account follows them), plus their username, name, follower count and verified badge. Pass their Instagram-scoped id (IGSID): the numeric id on their Instagram DM in list_inbox or on an Instagram webhook. INSTAGRAM'S RULE: it answers only for people who have MESSAGED the account (or tapped an ice breaker or menu); for anyone else the reply says the follow state cannot be read, which is not an error. Use it before rewarding a follower (a discount code to followers only) or to qualify a DM lead. Works on Page-linked and Instagram Login accounts. Free.

account.description: which Instagram account — an @handle or id from list_connector_accounts("instagram"); omit when there is one

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in, for THIS CALL ONLY: an id or exact name from list_brands, needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

pageId.description: Facebook Page id — omit when only one Page is connected

userId.description: the person’s Instagram-scoped id (IGSID), numeric, from their DM in list_inbox; an @username is not accepted by Instagram here
